svg.aria-label: Shapes of Curves in R^d: the Quotient Space
svg.title: Shapes of Curves in R^d: the Quotient Space
svg.desc: Top: one closed planar contour under the five nuisance actions that curve_shape functions remove: translation, scaling, rotation, re-parametrisation (the sample points slide along the same outline) and, for closed curves, the starting point. All five copies collapse to one point of the quotient space, the same shape. Bottom left: with scale=True the unit-length SRVFs lie on the pre-shape sphere; q2 is moved along its orbit to the best-aligned q2-star and the shape distance is the great-circle arc arccos of the inner product of q1 and q2-star. Bottom right: the optimiser alternates Kabsch rotation and dynamic-programming warps for align_iter rounds, with seed search and closure projection for closed curves.
svg.text: Shapes of Curves in R^d: the Quotient Space
Five nuisance actions on one contour all map to the same shape; distances live on the pre-shape sphere
unit length puts q on the sphere.
q₂* = best (R, γ, seed) copy of q₂
closed=True: seed search over start points
